mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with supply chain disruptions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a weak economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in weak economy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with strong labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over 3 months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decreases by more than 0.5% in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals accommodative monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5% in 1 month and UNRATE < 4%
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy in strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of decreasing FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE does not correlate with positive returns.
